first_contact: This is the first time scripts/lora_relay.py has spoken to real hardware. RADIO-RELAY.md described it as written to the RYLR998 datasheet and not yet run; the module answered AT with +OK.
regulatory_finding: THE MODULE SHIPS ON 915 MHz, which is the US ISM band. India's licence-exempt allocation is 865-867 MHz, so transmitting as-found would have been outside it at 22 dBm. Nothing was transmitted: probe is read-only. This is why the procedure configures and re-probes rather than assuming factory defaults are appropriate to where the hardware is.
readback_note: A command returning +OK has been accepted, not necessarily applied. The configuration above is the module's own answer to a fresh query, not an echo of what was typed.
